title: feat(notification): alert center, unread counter, and reactive toast triggers
body:
## Summary
This Pull Request integrates the **Notifications & Alerts** bounded context into the FullTank Web Application, addressing user stories **US-29** and **US-30**.

### Changes Included
- **Domain Model:** Defined `Notification` domain entity, severity levels (`info`, `success`, `warning`, `error`), and value types.
- **API Client & Assemblers:** Implemented client and data assemblers for notification feed endpoints with demo mock support.
- **State Management:** Integrated `useNotificationStore` for tracking alert state, active toast triggers, unread notification counts, and mark-as-read actions.
- **Views & Components:**
  - Reactive notification bell icon with badge counter in the navigation bar.
  - Notification list drawer / view with category filtering and time-ago formatting.
  - Toast message triggers on order approval and dispatch events.
- **Unit Testing:** Added Vitest unit test suite `tests/notification.store.spec.js` covering store actions, reactivity, and unread badge count calculations.

### Team Governance (LACX Matrix)
- **Leader (Author):** Frank Huingo (@Franz2308)
- **Approver (Code Reviewer):** Enrique Mantilla (@enrique-mantilla)

title: feat(fulfillment): fleet and driver logistics management
body:
## Summary
This Pull Request integrates the **Fulfillment & Fleet Logistics** bounded context into the FullTank Web Application, addressing user stories **US-44**, **US-45**, and **US-49**.

### Changes Included
- **Domain Entities:** Defined `Driver` and `Vehicle` domain entities with validation for license numbers, plate formats, and tank capacity limits.
- **API Client & Assemblers:** Implemented client and data assemblers for vehicle and driver endpoints with demo mock support.
- **State Management:** Created Pinia store `useFulfillmentStore` managing fleet assets, driver availability, and dispatch assignments.
- **Views & Components:**
  - Fleet management table with status filtering (available, maintenance, in transit).
  - Driver management registry with contact details and license expiration alerts.
  - Dispatch assignment dialog modal for linking cisterns and drivers to approved orders.
- **Routing:** Registered fulfillment routes protected by authentication and role guards.

### Team Governance (LACX Matrix)
- **Leader (Author):** Frank Huingo (@Franz2308)
- **Approver (Code Reviewer):** Brayan Corvacho (@BralexCD)

title: feat(iam): add demo authentication and session management
body:
Add demo sign-in, buyer/provider registration, company and account profile editing, password changes, restored sessions, and route access checks. Authentication redirects to the available home or requested profile route while reporting is pending. This PR imports and adapts IAM from Brayan's previous frontend; it does not import another BC or the historical full-project commit.

Four commits organize domain, infrastructure, application, and presentation. New commit subjects use English imperative.

Shared integration changes:
- Add a generic handler registry to the demo adapter; IAM owns its users, company fixtures, authentication commands, and validation in `src/iam/infrastructure/fake/`.
- Register IAM routes, public/guest metadata, role checks, ToastService, and a login/profile/logout header. Home and 404 remain accessible; `noShell` controls full-screen auth views separately from public access.
- Add IAM endpoint variables and ES/EN translations, document demo accounts and integration contracts, and isolate test localStorage.

Validation:
- `npm test`: 41/41 tests across six files (shared CRUD, IAM domain/API/store, session restoration and route access).
- `npm run build:demo`: passed.
- Chromium: protected-profile redirect, invalid credentials, buyer/provider sign-in, seeded-session reload, company edit, provider registration, logout, ES/EN, and 375px mobile views without overflow; no JavaScript exceptions.
- Delivery validator: clean `feat/iam`, current develop ancestry, 29 scoped files, permitted shared changes explicitly declared, and no historical full import.

Demo data is held in browser memory; created accounts and edits reset on page reload. Seeded accounts can restore their sessions. This is academic demo authentication. Eight other BCs remain for their assigned owners. Peer review is pending before integration into develop.

title: feat(shared): incorporar base minima de FullTank
body:
El repositorio parte de un README y necesita una aplicación que arranque antes de integrar los módulos. Esta entrega incorpora la base de Vue/Vite, Pinia, PrimeVue, traducciones ES/EN, inicio responsive y página 404.

Reutiliza configuración, recursos y utilidades del proyecto previo de Brayan. El router y el layout funcionan sin dependencias de otros BC. La infraestructura compartida ofrece un cliente Axios y CRUD demo en memoria, sin datos ni comandos de negocio precargados. Cada BC incorporará sus rutas, traducciones, componentes y operaciones en su propio PR; IAM y autenticación quedan para su entrega.

Validación:

- `npm ci`: instalación desde el lockfile.
- `npm run build:demo`: correcto.
- `npm test`: 10/10 pruebas de configuración HTTP, token de sesión, CRUD, consultas, errores y aislamiento de datos.
- Chromium: inicio ES, cambio a EN, imágenes, ancho de 375 px sin desbordamiento, 404 y regreso al inicio; sin excepciones de JavaScript.
- Alcance revisado: configuración, recursos y `src/shared`; ninguna carpeta de los nueve BC pendientes ni archivos generados.
